title: Wangchuk claims house arrest amid planned Ladakh protest, alleges security deployment outside home

ai.summary: Climate activist Sonam Wangchuk claims he is under house arrest with police and paramilitary personnel deployed outside his Ladakh residence, as he prepares for a sit-in protest over Ladakh's election timing and other demands.

facts.claim: Wangchuk claims he had been placed under house arrest
facts.quote: Wangchuk, who is a prominent member of Leh Apex Body (LAB), said he would challenge the restrictions on his movement before the appropriate legal forums, including the Magistrate, High Court and Supreme Court, questioning how a person could be prevented from participating in a peaceful protest without being formally arrested.

facts.claim: 20–25 police and paramilitary personnel deployed outside his residence
facts.quote: Leh, Nov 12 (PTI) A day after police removed Sonam Wangchuk from the protest site and escorted him to his residence, the climate activist on Thursday claimed that he had been placed under house arrest and around 20–25 police and paramilitary personnel had been deployed outside his Ladakh residence.

facts.claim: Security personnel stationed outside residence since Wednesday night
facts.quote: In a video message shared on his social media accounts, including X and Facebook, late Thursday night, the activist said several security personnel, along with multiple vehicles and tents, had been stationed outside his residence since Wednesday night.

facts.claim: Armed personnel deployed on all sides of his house
facts.quote: He also alleged that armed personnel were deployed on all sides of his house during the day, restricting his movement.

facts.claim: Wangchuk is preparing for a sit-in protest over Ladakh's election timing
facts.quote: Wangchuk said holding the elections during winter was "unacceptable", as a significant section of Ladakh’s population would be away from the region.

ai.background_note: Climate activist Sonam Wangchuk, a prominent member of Leh Apex Body (LAB), claims he is under house arrest as he prepares for a sit-in protest over Ladakh's election timing and other demands, including the release of a Commission of Inquiry report into a September 2025 incident.
